name: legal-evidence-workflows
description: Build source-linked document indexes, evidence chronologies, candidate-only privilege logs and inconsistency maps as Word documents from supplied legal matter documents while preserving conflicts, uncertainty and human review.

interface.shortDescription: Builds source-linked Word document indexes, chronologies, privilege logs and inconsistency maps from supplied matter documents without deciding credibility, privilege or merits.
interface.longDescription: Uses a native structured document-review table when available to work through supplied legal matter documents, then creates Word deliverables for practitioner review: a numbered document index with descriptions taken from the documents themselves, an event-level chronology with source pinpoints, uncertainty and conflicting accounts preserved, a candidate-only privilege log recording roles, purpose on the face, circulation and waiver flags, and a fact-by-source inconsistency map that quotes each competing passage. No workflow decides relevance, privilege, credibility, evidentiary weight, admissibility, legal effect or merits, and every output remains subject to human review.
defaultPrompt: Build a numbered, source-linked document index as a .docx file from these matter documents.
Build a source-linked evidence chronology as a .docx file from these matter documents and preserve conflicting accounts.
Prepare a candidate-only privilege log as a .docx file from these documents and leave every claim to me.
Map where these sources agree, diverge or are silent on each material fact as a .docx file, without deciding which account is right.
